pattern:
(?x)
  "                     # opening quote
  (?<key> [^"\]+ )     # the key text (no escape handling, kept simple)
  "
  \s* : \s*             # colon separator, optional surrounding whitespace

(?x)        # turn on extended mode
  -?        # an optional minus
  (?:
    0       # a zero
    |       # ...or...
    [1-9]   # a 1-9 character
    \d*     # followed by zero or more digits\
